■Stage Direction
[Mob Profile]
Age: Late 50s
Personality: Strict trainer
And above all else—

Whoa!?
Papa! A "!" popped up here!

I've seen her being scouted like that countless times already.
Even to a rookie like me, it was obvious she had more than enough talent to already have a Trainer.
What a magnificent run... This girl might just have what it takes to reach the top...!

I hurriedly covered it up. If my identity got out,
it would be hard to maintain our current relationship. I had to be careful.
A fah-n...?
Whoaa...!
"What if nobody who understands you ever scouts you?" ...huh.

...Hey.
Does anyone here... remember a story from when I was little?
Yay~! Daddy~! Mommy~! Did you see me!?

...I understand what you're saying. But... that's not how it is for me.
I'm sorry if you can't see it that way.
—"If the reason things aren't moving forward is your streaming"—
*Inhale*... *exhale*...!

I can take you to the heights you desire.
Why not unleash that talent in graded races... no, on the GⅠ stage?

Without thinking, I posted that question.
I just had to ask.

It's like entrusting my entire racing career to that person, after all.
It's a big deal, so I don't want to make a half-hearted choice.
「Is that right?! Wait, Bridge-san, are you someone who knows their stuff?」

...Fufu♪ That question might not even matter, honestly.
I've never even considered a path where I can't walk alongside everyone.

Looking solely at track records, I know it's an offer I definitely should take.
But—

Mommy, look at Loves's smile!
Ah, I want so many more people to see this smile...!

You're magnificent! Especially how well you sustain your speed!
How about developing that talent under my guidance?

Ufufu, yes, congratulations on winning♪
Mommy is so very happy, Loves♪

Unnecessary hassle and trouble lead to mental fatigue and injuries.
Considering your priorities as an athlete, you should understand this.

...
"...Aren't you scared?" ...

There are still plenty of Trainers at Tracen Academy.
It's just that my perspective differed from a few of them, that's all.

Come on, there's no way you're "taking away opportunities" from me.
I'm still getting plenty of time in for training, after all.
—"But if streaming becomes a hindrance to signing a contract"...?
Ahaha, it means people who "love" you, Loves!
The place where I—where I found my very own "love."

Fufu, you're right. How nostalgic.
...To me, this is the precious place where I first met everyone.
H-... Hel-lo-o?

...Fufu, really now.
There's no need to worry like that, you know.
「Aren't we robbing you of your opportunities?」
Loves Only You still doesn't have a Trainer.
「, we'd be fine with just watching over you from afar.」
"Just watching over me from afar"...?

Fufu, I'm truly honored to receive an offer
from a veteran with such an impressive track record.

「I'm sure you'll find a great mentor!」 ...Yeah, thank you so much♡
Things like this are all about fate, anyway.

"Must be a huge reason for it, huh?" Hmm... well, I suppose so.
Normally, anyone would jump at a scout from a GⅠ Trainer, right?

The next day.
Passing by the cafeteria, I spotted that familiar figure once again.

「You're so tiny and cute, but you run super fast!
I totally became a fan of yours after seeing that race!」

—"Excessive interaction with fans isn't necessary to get stronger."
The ones I've turned down so far all more or less shared that view.
—I turned it down♡
...Huff... huff... huff... huff...!

I apologize, but I must ask you to shut down this fan community of yours.
—That is a condition for our contract.

Look, Loves. This is the "stream" you said you wanted to try.
Look at this camera part right here and try saying ""?

Alright! Today's special event!
The winner of the kids' race is Loves Only You-chan!
「Loves-chan was so tiny back then~」...

Phew...! 
Yep, yep, today's feeling pretty good!

—So yeah, I received an offer, but...
I decided to pass on it this time.

「At Tracen Academy, you can't debut unless you have a Trainer,
right? Are you gonna be okay, Loves-chan? Like with your debut timing?」
Some time has passed since then.
